# Welcome to my website!

Hello everyone!

My name is Aryan Pasricha, and I am originally from Toronto, Canada. I am currently a Research Coordinator at the Cleveland Clinic's Heart, Vascular & Thoracic Institute (HVTI) and a part-time Master's student in the Clinical Research Scholars Program (CRSP). My research focuses on aortic disease, particularly the perioperative care and outcomes of patients with aortic aneurysms and dissections.

I moved to Cleveland over a year ago and have really enjoyed exploring the city, especially its small local shops, bars, and coffee shops. I am also a music fanatic who loves playing the guitar and performing country music.

Outside of work and school, I have two older brothers who both live in New York City. One works as a journalist and broadcaster, while the other works in investment banking.

Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:aap261@case.edu) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential projects.
